t: There is no creature on earth, and no bird flying on its wings, except that they are communities like you.
Do you not see that everyone in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, even the birds with wings spread?
There is no creature on earth whose provision is not upon Allah.
How many creatures cannot carry their own provision? Allah provides for them and for you.
He created the livestock for you; in them is warmth and many benefits. Be grateful.
Your Lord inspired the bee: make homes in the mountains, in the trees and in what people build.
The seven heavens, the earth and all within them glorify Him, though you do not understand their glorification.
An ant said: O ants, enter your homes, so Sulayman and his soldiers do not crush you without realising it.
He spread out the earth for all living creatures.
We have not sent you except as a mercy to all the worlds.
There is a reward for kindness to every living being.
A man gave water to a thirsty dog; Allah thanked him for it and forgave his sins.
A woman was forgiven because she gave water to a thirsty dog.
A woman entered Hell for a cat she shut up, neither feeding it nor letting it eat from the earth.
Allah created mercy in one hundred parts. Because of the one part sent to earth, even a mare lifts her hoof away from her foal.
The Prophet ﷺ cursed anyone who uses a living creature as a target.
A Prophet burned an ant colony. Allah said: because one ant bit you, you burned a community that glorifies Allah?
Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
Fear Allah regarding these animals that cannot speak.
Allah has prescribed excellence in everything. Even when slaughtering, sharpen your blade and spare the animal pain.
The greatness of a nation and its moral progress can be judged by the way its animals are treated.
Our task must be to free ourselves by widening our circle of compassion to embrace all living creatures.
Until he extends the circle of his compassion to all living things, man will not himself find peace.
The question is not, Can they reason? nor, Can they talk? but, Can they suffer?
He who is cruel to animals becomes hard also in his dealings with men.
Until one has loved an animal, a part of one's soul remains unawakened.
What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make.
If you pick up a starving dog and make him prosperous, he will not bite you. This is the principal difference between a dog and a man.
Dogs are not our whole life, but they make our lives whole.
